locations.secondary_policy: Keep London only for strong matches

closed_rule: Never mark CLOSED unless the relevant official source was successfully verified in the current run.
source_priority: official ATS or official career site
LinkedIn and aggregators for discovery only
cost_policy: No paid external services or APIs

seniority_policy.6_plus_mandatory: normally exclude unless an unusually strong and credible fit justifies review

fit_thresholds.policy: Milan/Rome use 70; London/Luxembourg use 80 for standard roles. Priority-company exhaustive reporting rules for Amazon and Mastercard override normal top-N/threshold suppression after scope/experience review.

purpose: discover vacancies missed by primary ATS/mapping

jd_mapping_policy.policy: A title containing Manager, Senior, Lead, Head or Director must never be rejected by title alone. Read the full JD first. Base inclusion on mandatory years, actual responsibility scope, people-management requirements and role level. Manager titles with <=5 mandatory years or junior/early-mid scope remain eligible.

semantic_analysis_execution.github_role: enumerate inventory, preserve state, generate semantic queue and audit
semantic_analysis_execution.chatgpt_role: open/read full JD, map mandatory vs preferred requirements, assess real seniority and fit, persist decision
semantic_analysis_execution.rule: A run may not claim semantic completeness while semantic_queue contains pending records.
semantic_analysis_execution.title_metadata_rule: ChatGPT may close a role from title/company/location/metadata only when it is clearly impossible to reach the fit threshold.
semantic_analysis_execution.full_jd_rule: Any plausibly relevant role requires full official-JD mapping; business-compatible Manager/Senior/Lead always requires full-JD review and is never excluded by title.

surface_registry_policy.standard_roles: Do not repeat unchanged STILL_OPEN roles after they have been surfaced; re-surface only NEW, materially UPDATED, newly reportable, or explicitly requested.
surface_registry_policy.priority_roles: Amazon in JW2 and Mastercard in JW1 are re-surfaced every daily run while open and in scope.
surface_registry_policy.write_order: Persist semantic decision first; write surfaced history only for roles actually included in the user-visible output; then re-run/sync state when possible.

priority: mapping level FULL but current coverage PARTIAL
partial_remediation_policy.method: Attempt a safer structured/public ATS endpoint, pagination contract, count reconciliation or official first-party inventory parser. Never upgrade coverage merely by changing a label.
partial_remediation_policy.verified_rule: Promote to VERIFIED only when the current run can exhaust and reconcile the official inventory.
partial_remediation_policy.logging: Keep unresolved portals PARTIAL with the concrete technical reason so the next run can retry or remap them.

daily_semantic_completion_policy.objective: A daily Job Watch run must fully process the current actionable delta without being blocked by the historical semantic backlog.
actionable_delta: all NEW vacancies in target geography
all open Amazon and Mastercard priority vacancies that are new/updated or not yet semantically decided
previously open never-surfaced roles that are selected for today's backlog tranche

backlog_policy.minimum_progress_rule: After the current delta is complete, use remaining run capacity to reduce the oldest/highest-value backlog. Never re-read unchanged already-decided JD fingerprints.

daily_semantic_completion_policy.daily_complete_rule: DAILY_COMPLETE when every actionable-delta item for the run is decided/reconciled and output persistence succeeds, even if historical backlog remains. Report backlog separately as BACKLOG_REMAINING.
daily_semantic_completion_policy.full_backlog_complete_rule: FULL_SEMANTIC_COMPLETE only when semantic queues contain no pending historical records.

company_self_improvement_policy.purpose: Continuously discover high-value employers outside the current watchlist without polluting the permanent company universe.
discovery_sources: official career sites reached from discovered roles
recurring high-fit employers surfaced by LinkedIn/Indeed/Glassdoor/other aggregators
candidate_requirements: at least one official open role in a target geography matching the user's business/strategy/finance profile
official careers/job source must be identifiable
company_self_improvement_policy.promotion_rule: Promote to the appropriate JW batch when either (A) at least 2 distinct validated in-scope roles are observed within 30 days, or (B) one Milan/Rome role has expected fit >=85 and the employer has attractive compensation/career relevance. London-only companies require stronger evidence and expected fit >=85.
company_self_improvement_policy.promotion_action: On promotion, add the company to companies_job_watch_v2.json and the correct job_watch_batches.json batch, then create/update an ATS mapping. If ATS cannot yet be mapped safely, keep the company staged and continue discovery.
company_self_improvement_policy.pruning_rule: Remove or archive a candidate after 60 days with no further relevant validated role.
no_auto_promotion_if: compensation/career value is clearly below current targets

reporting_efficiency_policy.priority_company_reporting: For Amazon and Mastercard, keep exhaustive inventory and semantic coverage in state files, but user-visible daily output should emphasize NEW/UPDATED/newly-decided high-fit roles plus concise counts. Do not print hundreds of unchanged STILL_OPEN rows unless explicitly requested.
reporting_efficiency_policy.standard_company_reporting: Show NEW, materially UPDATED, AUTONOMOUS_DELTA, newly reportable and never-surfaced relevant roles. Suppress unchanged already-surfaced STILL_OPEN roles.
reporting_efficiency_policy.audit_footer: Always include concise per-batch coverage, daily delta completeness, historical backlog remaining, FAILED/NOT_CHECKED counts, and new-company discovery changes.

persistence_batching_policy.rule: Accumulate semantic decisions and surfaced-history changes across all four JW modules during the daily run, then persist them in as few GitHub commits as practical before a single semantic sync/audit cycle.
persistence_batching_policy.reason: Avoid triggering one sync workflow per vacancy or per file and reduce GitHub Actions churn/race opportunities.
persistence_batching_policy.exception: If a critical write must be persisted before continuing, write it immediately; otherwise batch.
